findings: Checked the exact tree-source reachable sets and earliest selectors, including closure under cross edges from side nodes; strict ancestors ensure acyclicity. Interior sources have the same later selectors after their forced prefix.

Checked every non-root target case, all root minimizers and the last-leaf-vertex y endpoint restriction. The retained leaf chain gives count(Q)=count(P)-1, and the endpoint remains an important entry relative to y.

Checked the alpha,beta,height/stretch quantifiers and isolated padding n=M^2. Fixed height followed by unbounded stretch enforces L^3>n while preserving the counterexample inequalities and the required chain-cover bounds.

Independent implementation recomputed reachability/selectors and every important distance on eleven cores. In addition to nine small cases, active padded cases n=262144,L=70 and n=4194304,L=167 passed. Only the covered core was materialized; isolated padding changes no core distance.
scope: Informal symbolic proof with independent executable diagnostics, not a Lean theorem. It refutes the proposed near-maximum hereditary repair for supplied covers, including legal empty-H initial states. No counterexample to cubic raw-potential progress, a specified cover-construction implementation, or a main shortcut theorem is claimed.
